data.name: Boston City Hall
data.headline: New tour for 2025, exploring the ins and outs of Boston's historic City Hall
data.description:
Explore Boston City Hall with Boston By Foot on a free guided tour! Whether you love its striking brutalist design or think it's the ugliest building in the city, there is much to discover about this iconic landmark.

Join us as we explore City Hall’s unique design, its history, and how it serves the people of Boston today. On the tour, we’ll visit the grand ceremonial spaces, the public service areas, and the offices where elected officials and city employees work to make important decisions for our community.

As we walk through the building, you’ll learn about how its design reflects both the politics and the practicalities of running a city. We’ll discuss how City Hall’s architecture impacts the lives of Boston residents, and invite you to think about how the building works both in everyday life and as a symbol of our city’s values.

By the end of the tour, you’ll see City Hall in a whole new light and leave with a deeper understanding of its important role in Boston’s story. We hope you’ll feel inspired and connected to this welcoming place that helps shape the future of our city!

This tour is presented in partnership with the City of Boston.

Please review Boston City Hall's security procedures [here] (https://www.boston.gov/departments/property-management/boston-city-hall-security)

meeting_point.address: inside the Government Center MBTA Station at the entrance/exit facing City Hall.

data.cancellation_notes:
- Please arrive at least 10 minutes early to meet your guide. Late admittance is not guaranteed. 
- Public tours can be rebooked on another available tour, or canceled for full credit as a gift card, with at least 24hrs notice. Customers can conveniently cancel or rebook public tour registrations using the "change booking" and "cancel booking" links in the confirmation and reminder emails. Cancellations less than 24hrs prior to the tour start or no shows cannot be credited.
- Private tours can be canceled up to 4 days before the start for a full refund. Private tour cancellations made within 4 days of the tour date incur a small cancellation fee, though they can be rebooked for no additional fees. Contact us to cancel or rebook a private tour. 
- All tours are held in all weather - rain or shine. Please be prepared for the weather and to walk and stand outdoors on your tour. In case of tour cancellation by Boston By Foot due to extreme weather or unforeseen circumstances, you will be offered a refund or exchange. If groups choose to cancel a tour due to weather, the above policy stands.
data.booking_notes:
All visitors to City Hall must pass through security and will be subject to metal
detector, x-ray, visual, and/or security wand inspections. Individuals who refuse to comply with City Hall’s access procedures will be denied entrance to the building. 
- All visitors are encouraged to review the [City Hall Security Procedures PDF](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/DDFd91MbQk6SfFTkuXyi)
- All items brought into City Hall are subject to inspection. Bags and other articles are to be put through the X-ray machine and may be subject to additional visual inspection as
needed, including the opening and removal of items. 
- To ensure safety and a swifter entry process, City Hall Property Management strongly discourages guests from bringing large bags into City Hall. 
- Firearms, knives, mace, or other weapons, alcoholic beverages, illegal substances, flammable items, drones and large banners, flags or signs are prohibited. Items that are confiscated by City Hall Property Management will not be returned.
